title: 10 Small Compromises a Godly Man Refuses to Let Slide
caption:
None of these look like sin. That's exactly why they work.

A white lie that keeps the peace isn't peace, it's a loan, and it comes due. The private tab, the cut corner, the apology that isn't really an apology. Small compromises don't feel like compromise. They feel like Tuesday.

James 1:22: be doers of the word, not hearers only. The verse you read and don't obey isn't faith. It's information you're carrying around.

Kill the small ones before they grow into the ones with your name on them.
